integrity_statement: The all-integer proof is given in RESULT.md; verify.py only performs finite exact tests. No independent audit or external certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The envelope is proved for integer parameters in a symmetric integer interval and unweighted monomial coordinates; it need not hold for real parameters or rescaled embeddings. For sparse samples omitting extremal pairs it provides a strict bound but not the actual smaller diameter. Full-dimensionality requires at least d+1 points. Priority beyond inspected sources remains provisional.
title: An arithmetic parity law for the Euclidean diameter envelope of moment-curve polytopes
